name: Chill Guy
blurb: Phillip Banks's smirking dog in a sweater, the 2024 meme for staying calm no matter what
title: Chill Guy Meme: Meaning, Origin & "I'm Just a Chill Guy"
description: Chill Guy is a cartoon dog in a grey sweater drawn by artist Phillip Banks in October 2023; it went viral on TikTok in 2024 as the face of staying calm.
h1: What is the Chill Guy meme?
answer: Chill Guy is a drawing of a brown cartoon dog in a grey sweater, blue jeans and red sneakers, smirking with his hands in his pockets. American artist Phillip Banks posted it on X on 4 October 2023 as "my new character", a chill guy who "lowkey doesn't give a" care. It went viral on TikTok in September 2024 and again in November 2024 through "I'm just a chill guy" slideshows, standing for staying relaxed when things go wrong.

body: The picture is a simple digital drawing: an anthropomorphic dog with a relaxed half-smile and hands in his pockets, looking completely unbothered. In memes he stands for the person who stays calm while everything is chaotic, or who pretends to.

body.note: Banks's original caption called it "my new character" whose "whole deal is he's a chill guy". He later said he preferred the name Chill Guy over "My New Character", which is how many early TikToks labelled it.

head: Date
Event
rows: Phillip Banks posts the character on X and Instagram; it gets little traction at first.
TikTok slideshows and edits start using it (one dated 30 August); a 6 September edit with an AI voice and piano music becomes the template sound.
"I'm just a chill guy" slideshows set to Gia Margaret's piano track "Hinoki Wood" make it one of the biggest memes of the year.
Banks announces he has copyrighted the artwork and starts takedowns against unauthorised commercial uses.
Official merchandise follows, including plush toys and a Chill Guy pop-up in Hong Kong (11 April to 5 May 2025).

ul: "When the exam is in 10 minutes but you're just a chill guy"
"Me at work pretending everything's fine: just a chill guy"
Brands and sports teams posting their own Chill Guy versions in late 2024.
Cosplays and reaction images showing someone being unbothered.

body: The peak was November–December 2024; USA Today put it among the top memes of 2024. It is now a standard reaction image for being relaxed or nonchalant. Banks has defended his rights to the character, and claims in December 2024 that the drawing was plagiarised or was a hate symbol were shown to be hoaxes.

faq.a: Someone relaxed and unbothered. In the meme it is the attitude of staying calm, or acting calm, while things go wrong.

faq.q: Who drew the Chill Guy dog?
faq.a: American artist Phillip Banks, who posted it on 4 October 2023.

faq.q: What is the Chill Guy song?
faq.a: Most slideshows use "Hinoki Wood", a piano piece by Gia Margaret.
